title:
Comment of Sarah E Templeton in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 11/2/2026

documents.name: 152077.txt
documents.text:
Sarah E Templeton, KENAI, AK.
I personally want to intervene in the permit process for Deepgreen Cook Inlet spv llc. The implications of the data center would be grossly underestimated and would be detrimental to the endangered Cook Inlet beluga whales, all the species of the Salmon population just to name a couple. 
As a member of the community I feel very strongly that not one individual in this community would support this! Please protect our fragile ecosystem. Citizens of the Kenai peninsula are opposed.

Thank you
Sarah Templeton
